name: liquid-glass
title: Liquid Glass
summary: Apple's liquid glass material: the backdrop blurs and bends at the edges, with a rim that catches the light.
use_when: A floating bar, toolbar or button over photos, video, maps or a scrolling feed
One focal surface over a rich background
avoid_when: Over a flat solid background: there is nothing to bend
Glass inside glass, except a Tab Bar's own lens

props.bend: How far the rim bends the backdrop, as a share of the bend band (1)
props.dispersion: Colour split at the rim: 0.6 bends red 12% further than blue
props.frost: Blur behind the glass in px (3)
props.rim: Brightness of the rim light, 0 to 1 (0.3 light, 0.13 dark)
props.radius: Corner radius in px, 999 is a pill
props.pressable: Grow and spring back when pressed

a11y: Text on glass must still reach 4.5:1 at the busiest point of the background
